The '''Avenue of Flowering Trees''' was a road that was located in the city of [[Gadrin]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Description==
The avenue had a series of regularly spaced exotic trees along it's sides. They were brightly colored and smelled very pleasant. As a result, it became a tourist attraction and many people believed that it was worth visiting Gadrin, or even Cularin, just to see the avenue.
